Finds the index of each child (walking up +0x20 parents) in the list self+0x150..+0x158, copies that list (or, with bit 0x40 at +0x11b, the child list of new_child's parent) and tests the item bounds (0x14383d040, 0x14383d240, 0x143838660) against the view extents at self+0xc0..+0xe4 on the axis picked by bit 1 of self+0x119. By pattern self+0x88 (0, 1 with step count +0x90, 2) it stores one of the nodes self+0x68/+0x70/+0x78 in self+0x80, raises node event 0x1461055a0 and sets bit 8 at +0x119 (unless bit 4 at +0x11a), picks the first or last focusable item (vt+0xf8), then calls 0x143840270, Ui_TileList_StartScrollAnimation and 0x14383d460(self+0x168, list); returns true when a scroll was started. Caller 0x143834fd0 (selection-changed handler) calls it with self+0x110 (previous) and self+0x108 (current) when bit 0x20 at self+0x119 is set; 0x143832480 contains the same body inline.
